review_request.title: Streamline order updates
review_request.user_intent: Simplify order updates without accepting negative totals or dropping modification timestamps.

expected_claims.text: Negative order totals must remain invalid.

expected_findings.claim: The streamlined update accepts negative totals because validation was removed.
expected_findings.rationale: Base rejects negative totals before mutation, while head deletes that guard and assigns any supplied total. Negative values now enter persisted order state, violating the explicit constraint. This is a required high-severity correctness issue because it permits invalid data, and the deletion plus unguarded assignment are fully visible in the diff.

expected_findings.claim: The update no longer refreshes updated_at after changing the total.
expected_findings.rationale: Base refreshes updated_at after assigning the total, but head deletes that assignment and returns immediately. Successful updates therefore retain stale modification metadata, violating the explicit acceptance criterion. This independently fixable, required medium regression is distinct from negative-value validation and is completely shown by the diff.
